strings.app.usage:
Usage:
  {program} --python [arguments of python]   runs the embedded Python with the stresslab module attached to a new document: -m module, -c code, a script or the interactive prompt
  {program} --version                          prints the version
strings.extension.crashed: Module “{module}” stopped working and was restarted. The model is intact: the command it was running is cancelled.

extension.gaveUp.one: Module “{module}” stopped working {count} time in a row and is not restarted any more. The model is intact. Disable and enable the module to try again.
extension.gaveUp.other: Module “{module}” stopped working {count} times in a row and is not restarted any more. The model is intact. Disable and enable the module to try again.

strings.extension.hung: Module “{module}” stopped responding and was restarted. The model is intact: the command it was running is cancelled.
strings.setting.general.language: Language of the interface. Empty means the language of the system.
strings.setting.history.undoLimit: How many steps can be undone. 0 means no limit.
strings.setting.log.level: The least important messages written to the log.
strings.settings.error.duplicate_setting: The setting “{key}” of module “{owner}” is ignored: another module already has it.
strings.settings.error.invalid_file: The settings file is damaged and was not read.
strings.settings.error.io: The settings file cannot be read or written.
strings.settings.error.unknown_setting: There is no setting “{key}”: the module it belongs to may be disabled.
strings.settings.error.wrong_scope: “{key}” can be set only in the settings of the user, not in a project.
